segments.text: “Um…why did someone like me suddenly become an attendant to Lady Antonia?”

A servant at Schönbrunn Palace. A cheerful and positive-thinking woman. She is working as an attendant to Marie Antoinette. As her entire family is employed at the castle, they live in lodging quarters on the premises. She has loved books since she was a child, so much that she taught herself to speak French.
“I’ll say it now; I have no interest in marriage. And I have no interest in you. Go ahead and spend your time as you wish.”
The crown prince of France and the eventual king. Perturbed by nothing, an apathetic and unimpressed man. He feels he is unsuited to being the crown prince, and views everything in the long term.
“You and I are the only two people here… It’s okay, no one is looking.”
Hobby: Language Study (Swedish, French, German, English, Spanish)

A nobleman and soldier of Sweden. A gentleman who speaks politely. His personality is earnest, but he makes it a rule to enjoy matters of love and romance. So popular that he is always surrounded by ladies wishing to dance with him at balls. He is close with the Marquis Lafayette, always speaking with him whenever he comes to France.
“I’m not sure what it is you’re hiding, but I think it might be best if you give it up before his Highness finds out.”
Hobby: Collecting Asian Works of Art

A nobleman and soldier of France. A man with a strong sense of justice, he detests things that are twisted. He acts the same even to those of low social standing. He has sharper than average intuition and perception when it comes to his work, but he’s dense about everything else. He is friends with Count Fersen, and the two of them practice their swordplay together whenever the Count is in France.
“They bow their heads, obeying whatever they’re told without opposition, right? Lower than dogs!”

A French university student. Ambitious and uncivil, an extremely smart, intellectual man. At first glance he may seem like the cool type, but he has an unexpected side. He tends to pursue a given matter relentlessly until he can understand it, and is often told he’s stubborn. He’s known Danton for several years, an undesirable yet inseparable relationship.
“Anyway, don’t worry over it all by yourself. I can’t do anything to help you, but if you need to talk, I’ll listen as much as you want.”

A French lawyer. He’s the type to jump right into things all fired up, forcefully dragging everyone around him along for the ride. It seems like he doesn’t think things through, but he’s intent on “doing things his own way”. Cheerful and frank, he’s warm and softhearted towards the circumstances of others. An acquaintance of Robespierre, he feels like he can’t leave him alone by himself.

cast.characterName: マリー・アントワネット
cast.originalCharacterName: マリー・アントワネット

segments.text: "...Me, I just want to live freely. I really want to fly out of here and go into town to just do whatever I want."
The French Crown Princess and later Queen.
A person who likes new things and experiences but hates rules and customs.
She's a bit of a selfish tomboy, but she is considerate towards her mother and her maid Liese.
"Surrounded by all these young people, I almost feel like I've become younger myself, haha."
Likes: Beautiful Women and Delicious Food
A sociable man who gives off a friendly atmosphere, he loves to eat and laugh.
No matter how old he gets he's never lost his intrest in women.
He often listens to the crown princess's worries about her relationship with the crown prince.
"...I can't lose to that Austrian girl at our first meeting. I have to be even fancier."
She has a lot of pride and can't be settle down unless she is considered the best.
She boasts about bringing herself up from being a commoner to becoming the kings mistress.
She holds animosity towards Marie for not knowing herself.
"You're not alone, if you're worried you can rely on me. We might not meet again, but I'll at least send you letters."
She's usually kind, but as an empress she knows to be dignified.
She's always worrying about her daughter Marie and her letters to her are always filled with scoldings.
"Just put it on and come here already! This is all for the sake of Austria, for Antonia's sake!"
Likes: Reaping the Fruit of One's Labors
Dislikes: Not Being Able to Concentrate on Work
A person who looks older than his years because he is always worrying.
He has a serious personality and always loyally notices the fine points of his orders.
He is always scolding the protagonist and manipulating Marie Antoinette.
"I serve God, I do everything according to God's will. I say that but, it really is hard you know?"
A French priest, he's one of Marie Antoinette's tutors.
A kind person who never gets angry.
He's always being taken advantage of by the protagonist, Marie, and Count Mercy.
But he's always willing to give advice when the protagonist is worrying.
"...Duke Barry, hunting is something to be very careful about. You don't want to be mistaken for an animal and shot."
The one in control of the region of Provence.
A prideful and jealous person, he considers anything that happens to be his older brother Louis XVI's (Duke Barry) fault.
He isn't satisfied that the unmotivated Louis would make a good king just because he's a year older.
He's always disagreeable and prejudiced against Louis, but he always gets left out of things and is made fun of by his younger brother the Count of Artois.
"Crown Princess, you should pay more attention to your surroundings. With one word people would die for you, you know?"
The one in control of the region of Artois.
An optimistic and surprisingly family minded person, but he has an exclusive way of thinking.
He's Louis XVI and the Count of Provence's younger brother, but he's the most reliable one among them.
One one hand he thinks that there's a time to have fun and that's fine, but he still worries about Louis XVI and Marie.
"Of course, I am one of Antoinette's attendants. I'm the one who understands her the best and I offer my services to her."
A plain and gentle person, she doesn't like when people stand out when they shouldn't.
She didn't know what to do after her husband died, but she unexpectedly realized that she felt that being Marie's attendant is her purpose in life.
She thinks of herself as a good friend that can talk to Marie about anything.
"What a strange guest... Those kids are too, but you might be even stranger."
She's usually gentle and seems timid, but she actually has a strong heart.
After her husband died she runs the hotel all by herself.
The protagonist thinks of her like a kind mother, but she can be strict sometimes.
"My job is to fix your hair. Putting it up~ letting it down~ hiding all the sloppy places~ Yes It's all done!"
He loves beautiful men and making rankings of them, the type of person who says everything bluntly.
He used to be in charge of costuming and hairdressing opera singers, but now he works in the palace taking care of all the noble ladies.
He's confident of the way he came up this far from being a commoner.
"Oh no, I'm sorry. It's no good, when I see something cute I just get so excited."
A composed woman with good sense.
She is often considered strange when she gets caught up in one of her new ideas.
